hypothesis: Reducing the FM latent dimension from k=16 to k=8 will reduce variance and improve validation ranking metrics without changing the data pipeline.
git_diff:
diff --git a/experiments/run_date_dow_fm.py b/experiments/run_date_dow_fm.py

+++ b/experiments/run_date_dow_fm.py
@@ -24,7 +24,7 @@ def main() -> None:
     encoded, dimension = encode(development)

     x_valid, y_valid, users_valid = encoded["valid"]
-    model = FM(dimension, k=16, lr=0.001, seed=seed)

     rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
description: Run the existing FM experiment with one controlled capacity change: k=8 instead of k=16. Use only train and valid development splits.
result_compare: Compare GAUC, nDCG@5, and primary against run-1 seed 42 and run-9 seed 43 baseline results.
next_steps: Keep k=8 only if primary improves beyond the seed variation observed in runs 1 and 9; otherwise retain k=16.
